Jobs Pay Post a Job

Referrals, in plain English

Know another Michigan shop that hires controls techs? Send them our way with your code: they get $50 off their first post, and when they pay, you earn a free Featured upgrade. Here is the whole deal — this page is the entire agreement.

How it works

Every employer who posts with us gets a personal referral code (it looks like REF-YOURCOMPANY). It arrives in the email confirming your post. Share it however you like: forward it, text it, mention it at the supply house.

When a new employer enters your code on the post-a-job form (or mentions it by email) before paying, they get $50 off their first paid post — we send them a checkout link with the $50 already taken off (or credit $50 back the moment their payment clears). When that first paid post goes live, your reward is earned. That's the whole mechanism — nothing is tracked secretly, and no reward is owed for anything short of a paid post.

What you earn — and what they get

  • They get $50 off their first paid post, any tier (at the regular public prices).
  • You get a free Featured upgrade on your next Standard post — your post gets the weekly candidate-email feature and top placement.

One reward per employer you refer who pays. Refer three employers who pay, earn three rewards — they stack. You can apply one reward per post. Rewards are valid for 12 months from the day they're earned, and we'll always tell you by email when one lands and when one is about to expire.

What counts — and what doesn't

  • The referred employer must be a genuinely separate business — not your own company under another name, and not a second location of your business (second locations have their own $49 deal at checkout).
  • The reward lands when the referred employer's first paid post goes live.
  • The code must reach us before they pay for their first post — on the form, or in an email to us — so the $50 can come off that post. We can't apply codes retroactively to posts already paid for and live.
  • The $50 referral discount applies at the regular public prices and can't be combined with founding-cohort quoted prices — those employers already hold a lower locked quote.
  • Rewards are credit with us only — no cash value, and they stay with your company (not transferable to another business).
  • If a referred post is refunded, the reward it generated comes back too. Fair both ways.

The spirit of it

This program exists because a controls manager's recommendation is worth more than any ad we could buy. The reward is deliberately modest — a thank-you, not a bounty — and the terms are deliberately short. If anything here is ever unclear, email us and a human answer comes back. If we ever change these terms, the change applies only to referrals made after the change; rewards already earned stay earned.
